metadata.description: Cross-domain thinking, multi-model tooling, and developer productivity plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: distill
plugins.description: Iteratively decompose complex systems into their essential primitives.

plugins.name: lateral-thinking
plugins.description: Generate non-obvious hypotheses by decomposing a problem to its mechanism and raiding distant fields.

plugins.name: codex-exec
plugins.description: Run the Codex CLI for non-interactive coding work. Second opinions, adversarial review, and multi-model consensus.

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Navigate pages, fill forms, click buttons, take screenshots, extract data.

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Structured architecture debate: Claude proposes, Codex critiques, Claude synthesizes into a final ADR with concrete next steps.

plugins.name: beautiful-mermaid
plugins.description: Render Mermaid diagrams as SVG and PNG using the Beautiful Mermaid library.

plugins.name: bun-expert
plugins.description: Expert guidance for JavaScript/TypeScript development with the Bun runtime. Covers setup, servers, APIs, testing, bundling, and Node.js migration.

plugins.name: claude
plugins.description: Run Claude Code CLI for code analysis and automated edits. Delegate tasks, continue sessions, get machine-readable output.

plugins.name: cli-design-expert
plugins.description: Design or review command-line interfaces for usability and automation: help text, flags, exit codes, TTY behavior.

plugins.name: code-simplifier
plugins.description: Simplify and refine code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving all functionality.

plugins.name: dead-code-eliminator
plugins.description: Audit a codebase for dead code: unreachable functions, unused imports, orphaned classes, stale feature flags.

plugins.name: dokploy
plugins.description: Operate Dokploy via the official CLI. Manage projects, environments, apps, env vars, and databases from the terminal.

plugins.name: human-writer
plugins.description: Edit prose so it sounds natural, specific, and human-written. Use when a draft feels generic or model-generated.

plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Always-on project memory workflow. Read and update .agents/LEARNINGS.md with mistakes, corrections, patterns, and preferences.

plugins.name: pi
plugins.description: Claude-native planner/generator/evaluator harness for long-running engineering work, with optional Codex critique at high-leverage checkpoints.

plugins.name: plannotator
plugins.description: Interactive plan review, code review, and markdown annotation UI for Claude Code, backed by the external plannotator binary.

plugins.name: review-and-commit
plugins.description: Review uncommitted Git changes for correctness, quality, and convention alignment, then prepare safe, atomic commits.

plugins.name: scratch
plugins.description: Understand an existing project by playing with its real modules in a .scratch/ workspace.

plugins.name: socratic-code-owner
plugins.description: Quiz the developer on code, architecture, or plans an AI agent built. Ensures the human has a bulletproof mental model.

plugins.name: try
plugins.description: Evaluate a new library, tool, or GitHub repo before adopting it. Prompt-driven demos and honest findings.

plugins.name: visualize
plugins.description: Generate a self-contained HTML visualization to explain a system, plan, code flow, or concept.
